sonnet.problem: The punchline "He just ran out of directions!" makes God the subject of the joke and implies a limit on Him. The joke should stay on the human side of the moment.
sonnet.rule: Comparisons stay on the human side of the moment.

sonnet.problem: This punchline repeats the shape of the card 8 joke in the same stop: "friend, I [couldn't/only go back as far as]…", a self-deprecating comparison against the verse. It also sets his bargain bin and 25-cent sticker against God's "from eternity."
sonnet.rule: Each joke idea, comparison and punchline shape is used once per lesson.
